previous_statement: By the registered definition def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data, at the nondegenerate fixed point 0 of T the local fixed-point index is J(T,0)=sgn det(I-DT_0). Since DT_0=A, this is J(A,0)=sgn det(I-A), agreeing with the local Brouwer-degree computation in node 1.3.2.
new_statement: Use a compact extension of the germ before invoking def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data: realize the linear germ T(y)=Ay at 0 as the germ at a point p of a smooth self-map G of a compact orientable torus M. The registered definition then gives ind(G,p)=sgn det(I-A), and locality plus coordinate invariance of the local fixed-point index identifies ind(G,p)=J(T,0)=J(A,0).
